svg.text: 1/2" PLYWOOD LINER, IMPACT RESISTANT INTERIOR FINISH
2X6 STUDS @ 16" O.C., DOUBLE TOP PLATE, PT SILL
TYPE W1 · EXTERIOR WOOD STUD WALL · UNCONDITIONED · NO RATING · NO INSULATION (ADD PER ENERGY CODE IF CONDITIONED)
2X6 E WALL END STUD ON LAYOUT,
WSP SHEATHING, EDGE NAIL AT CORNER
LAP SIDING + WRB, WRAP WRB 12" MIN.
STUDS 2X6 @ 16" O.C. DOUBLE TOP PLATE, LAP SPLICES 48" MIN. PT
HEADERS (2) 2X8 + 1/2" PLY WITH KING + JACK STUDS EACH SIDE.
VERIFY SIZE WITH SPAN TABLES OR STRUCTURAL CALC.
1/2" ANCHOR BOLTS, 7" MIN. EMBED, 6'-0" O.C. MAX., ONE BOLT
WITHIN 12" OF EACH PLATE END (NOT CLOSER THAN 7 BOLT DIAMETERS).
MATCHES IRC R403.1.6 LANGUAGE. VERIFY ADOPTED CODE.
WSP SHEATHING IS THE WALL BRACING. PANEL LAYOUT, NAILING AND ANY
HOLD-DOWNS PER IRC R602.10 BRACING OR AN ENGINEERED SHEAR WALL
END WALLS (E + W) ARE RAKE WALLS: STUDS CUT TO THE SLOPE, TOP
PLATE FOLLOWS THE RAFTER LINE, END RAFTER BEARS ON IT.
VERIFY WITH A LICENSED PROFESSIONAL + THE AHJ
DRAWUP TYPICAL LEARNING CONTENT · NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · EVERY VIEW ON EVERY SHEET IS CUT FROM ONE BUILDING MODEL, SO TAGS, DIMENSIONS + LEVELS AGREE ACROSS THE SET.
